query: Draft an outbound sequence for these 20 accounts that just raised a Series A, using our CRM notes.
expected_behavior: Builds a 3-5 step sequence with subject lines, body copy, CTAs, personalization markers, and operator notes
Anchors the outreach to the funding trigger and other real signals from the provided data
Traces every claim to a source and flags assumptions explicitly
Climbs the personalization ladder rather than sending one generic template
